birth_time_sensitivity/approximate_hour.method: Classifications (every non-numeric value each resampled path prints: the sign of every longitude, angle, cusp and Lot; house placements of planets and Lots; motion direction; sect and its near-horizon band; the Lot formula basis; the void-of-course flag only) are recomputed at the listed sampled instants of the stated civil hour [H:00,H+1:00) in the named fold: a quarter-hour grid plus the seconds either side of any UTC-offset change inside the hour, located by a one-minute UTC scan refined to the second. same_at_all_samples means only that those sampled instants agree; it is not proof that the classification holds between them, and no invariant is applied to exclude a change and reversal between adjacent samples. Adjacent samples that differ are bisected to at most 15 s; each bracket holds at least one change, not necessarily one. Inside the polar circle the Ascendant can reverse between samples, so every path read off it is at most partially evaluated. Numeric values are sampled envelopes, not states. Every sample fails closed when its calculation did not use the Swiss files.

birth_time_sensitivity/date_only.method: Classifications of bodies and nodes (every non-numeric value they print: sign, motion direction, reason codes) are recomputed at the listed sampled instants of the local civil day, every instant the zone labels with the date (one or more UTC stretches): every existing hourly clock label on both folds, the first and last second of each stretch, and the seconds either side of every UTC-offset change that fall on the date, located by a one-minute UTC scan refined to the second. same_at_all_samples means only that those sampled instants agree; it is not proof that the classification holds between them, and no invariant is applied to exclude a change and reversal between adjacent samples. Numeric values are sampled envelopes, not states. Every sample fails closed when its calculation did not use the Swiss files.

chiron/physical_parameters.note: Apparent diameter and magnitude use the parameters built into Swiss Ephemeris, not the current JPL SBDB solution: the diameter is about 63.5% larger and the magnitude about 0.96 mag fainter than SBDB values. The position comes from the Swiss seas_18 file; measured against JPL#171 relative to the Sun it agrees within 0.04 arcsec at 1987, 2000 and 2024 and differs by up to 1.48 arcsec at 2399. attribution.attribution_source: Placidus de Titis, Tabulae primi mobilis, Padua: Frambotti 1657, Theses ex II. libro, no. 50, p.9: the commonly so-called antiscia are renamed 'Parallelos', defined as equally distant from the equator and taken from the declination table; in the same hemisphere 'primarius seu intuens', in opposite hemispheres commanding and obeying (the contra-parallel). Placidus presents this as Ptolemy's relation of signs of equal rising and the same parallel (Tetrabiblos I.14-I.15), which concerns signs, not bodies.
attribution.note: The date is that of the cited printed definition, not a claim of earliest use; earlier uses are not checked. Whether the declinations include planetary latitude is not asserted. The technique is not presented as Hellenistic or medieval.

eclipses/classification_borderline.note: Over 1181 solar eclipses 1900-2399 the Swiss type or centrality differs from the NASA canon in 7 cases, all within the canon's own classification margin. library_info.note: 兩者是不同的版本號：前者是 pip 安裝的 pyswisseph 套件版本，後者是其內建 Swiss Ephemeris C 函式庫自報的版本，數字格式相近但並非同一個值。tz_database 是本地時間換算所用的 IANA 時區資料庫版本，它不由本產品固定：macOS 由作業系統提供、容器由 image 提供，更新後同一組輸入可能換算出不同的 UTC。

lots.sources: Paulus, Eisagōgika ch.23 (Boer 1958, main text; Schmidt/Hand 1995 pp.43–45; neither edition checked), the cleanest witness: the Greek-Latin first printing (Wittenberg: Lehmann, 1586), chapter on the seven lots of Panaretus, reverses Fortune and Spirit at night. Valens III.11 (Pingree p.147; = III.14 Kroll/Riley, '14K;11P') also uses the day formula at night once the Moon has set: not adopted (Greenbaum, Culture and Cosmos 11, 2007, p.183). Abū Maʿshar's line via al-Bīrūnī, Tafhīm §476 (Wright 1934); Abbr. VI.3–4 and Bonatti not checked. Named disagreement not adopted: Ptolemy III.10 (Robbins pp.275–277) = III.11 (Hübner), Fortune Sun to Moon by day and night (Sun:ASC = Moon:Fortune); at night it falls on the reversing Spirit's degree (Rhetorius, CCAG VIII/4 p.121, via Greenbaum 2007 p.181). Ptolemy gives no Spirit formula there; a non-reversing Spirit attributed to Ibn Ezra is not checked.

lots/boundary_policy.rule: sect_status == boundary_both_shown 時，fortune／spirit 是依 >0° 判準的主要值；by_sect 中另一日夜盤公式的結果並列為比較值，不隱藏；落宮與相位只用主要值

planetary_hours.day_ruler_rule_boundary: the weekday is read from the sunrise's civil date; where two consecutive sunrises fall on one civil date or skip one (near polar transitions) the Chaldean sequence across the two days does not continue, and the product does not adjust it
planetary_hours.definition: Planetary day from sunrise to the next sunrise; twelve equal day hours sunrise→sunset and twelve equal night hours sunset→next sunrise (unequal or seasonal hours); hours ruled in the Chaldean order Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon; the first hour's ruler is the weekday ruler of the sunrise's civil date in the request time zone
planetary_hours.not_applicable_rule: applicable only when the sunrise before and the sunrise after the instant are at most 1.5 days apart with exactly one sunset between them (the horizon module's diurnal regime); otherwise no_sunrise_sunset_cycle_around_instant
planetary_hours.source_note: Cassius Dio, Roman History XXXVII.19: the weekday names follow from giving the planets, from Saturn on, to the successive hours of day and night. Dio defines neither unequal hours nor a day starting at sunrise; those are the standard later tradition, for which no primary text is cited. No page numbers
planetary_hours.sunrise_definition: the horizon module's event: refracted upper limb crossing the apparent horizon, topocentric, request atmosphere, no dip (USNO standard definition; Swiss swe_rise_trans default)

sect.sources: Passages (not independently verified): Dorotheus I.1 (Pingree pp.161–162), I.22 (p.183); Ptolemy I.7 (Robbins p.43); Valens III.5 (Pingree pp.133–134); Paulus ch.6, ch.23 (Boer 1958, main text; Schmidt 1995 pp.13, 43); Firmicus II.7.1–4; Rhetorius ch.2, ch.44 (Holden 2009 numbering, a compilation of epitomes; not verified); Abū Maʿshar, Great Introduction II.9.1 (locator not verified), Abbreviation III.3 (Dykes ITA §III.2); al-Qabīṣī I (Latin 1512); Lilly 1647 p.113 (Hayz), p.42. Most treat a diurnal or nocturnal birth as a given category, or describe planetary conditions as above or below the earth; the closest to a solar day/night criterion are Valens III.11 (Pingree; = III.14 Kroll/Riley, '14K;11P'; the Moon 'above the earth' read as until it sets) and Lilly 1647 p.42 (checking the chart time by the Sun's house). None specifies sun-centre, upper limb or refraction; the >0° rule is a product convention.

sect/near_horizon_band.geometric_reason: 標準視日出（上緣初現）時太陽中心約在幾何地平下 50′（折射約 34′＋太陽半徑約 16′），故 −50′ < h ≤ 0° 是幾何中心判準與視日出判準會分歧的區間；本產品對稱擴成 ±50′ 作為敏感提示帶。
sect/near_horizon_band.time_span_note: 依緯度與季節而異：低緯每次穿越約數分鐘，60°N 至點約 20 分鐘，更高緯可達數十分鐘，近極圈時太陽可能整夜停在帶內；不給固定分鐘數。

time/delta_t_model.provenance: Swiss 2.10.03 calc_deltat(): SMH 2016 model before 1955 (1000-day transition), dt[] table 1955–2028 (2024–2028 extrapolated), long-term formula beyond; σ orders from NASA GSFC (Espenak): Stephenson & Houlden 1986 to 1962, Huber 2000 after 2028

time/prc_1988_dst_start.note: 部分中文說明表把 1988 年中國夏令時間的起點寫成 4 月 10 日。本服務依 IANA 時區資料庫（4 月 17 日 02:00 起）換算，不另算一張盤；出生時間落在 1988-04-10 00:00 至 04-17 02:00（北京時間）之間時加一則警告，說明兩種說法的 UTC 相差 1 小時。
time/prc_1988_dst_start.source: IANA tz database, file asia: Rule PRC 1987 1991 - Apr Sun>=11 2:00 1:00 D (1988-04-17 02:00); comment by P Chan (2018-05-07) citing the first page of People's Daily of 1988-04-12, which states that summer time is to begin on 17 April; adopted in tz release 2018f. U.S. Naval Observatory (1989-01-19, quoted in the same file) also gives APR 17.

time/sidereal_time_model.source: Swiss Ephemeris 2.10.03 swe_sidtime / swe_sidtime0 (swephlib.c SIDT_LTERM_T0, SIDT_LTERM_T1)

time/xinjiang_civil_time_basis.note: 新疆同時使用北京時間（Asia/Shanghai）與新疆時間（Asia/Urumqi，慢 2 小時）。目錄裡國別為中國、時區為 Asia/Urumqi 的地點、三個目錄給北京時間的新疆地點（博樂、阿拉山口、依吞布拉克），以及手動輸入座標而時區為 Asia/Urumqi 或 Asia/Kashgar 的請求，計算前必須由使用者指明出生紀錄用哪一種；服務不預設。
time/xinjiang_civil_time_basis.source: IANA tz database, file asia, comments on Asia/Urumqi: Luther Ma (2009-10-17, 2014-04-22) on Beijing time and Xinjiang time both in use; Paul Eggert (2014-06-30): Xinjiang Time is officially recognized, no good records before 1986

boundary_simultaneity_policy.note: simultaneous_boundary：某個相位精確完成的時刻與月亮離開本星座的時刻，相差不超過求根容差 1e-06 日（約 0.086 秒），數值上分不出先後。此情形既不判為空亡、也不判為非空亡：is_void_of_course 為 null，verdict 為 simultaneous_boundary；該相位與兩個根的括號區間一併列出，供複算。

present_instant_policy.note: 盤上時刻月亮距精確相位 1 角秒以內（剛要完成或剛完成都算）的相位，與相位表的「此刻精確」同一標準；它此刻正在完成，故計入空亡判定（月亮不空亡）。它與未來相位分列兩個欄位以便分辨；all_candidates 只列未來相位，第一個最快完成。

source_verification.consequence: method_status cannot be raised to adopted until the attribution is settled against a named edition
consulted: Māshāʾallāh, On Reception ch.1 (Dykes 2008 p.443, in the translator's published excerpt pp.443-446)
Sahl, 'De cursu planete vacui', in Quadripartitum Ptolomei ... (Venice 1519; Seville copy, archive.org ARes08317, PDF p.246, left column)
source_verification.exact_perfection: Later literature attributes requiring exact perfection before the sign exit to Al H. Morrison (an article in the AFA Journal, October 1966; the article was not read); an earlier origin has not been checked.
not_consulted: Al H. Morrison, 'Void of Course Moon Periods: Their Uses and What May Come of Ignoring Them', AFA Journal XXVIII.10 (October 1966) p.10: located through the AFA journal author index; the article was not read
Sahl, Introduction §5.10 (Dykes 2008 p.35) and the Arabic text
source_verification.sign_condition: The Moon not perfecting an aspect before leaving its sign: Māshāʾallāh, On Reception ch.1 (Dykes 2008 p.443; ch.7, p.467, not checked); Lilly, Christian Astrology 1647 p.112 'Voyd of course' (bounded by the sign; the page does not mention moieties). Sahl's definition in the Latin Quadripartitum collection (Venice 1519) is that the Moon joins no planet and none joins it; it names neither the sign boundary nor an orb. An earlier explicit statement is attributed to Abū Maʿshar, Abbreviation III.21-22 (not consulted).
